serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Oh man…{{wi}} We have been here for a few hours already… {{wi}}How can girls just dress up for so long…
You: A-are you perhaps close to finishing things up? 
Lady Annalie: What are you talking about?! We're not even halfway there!
You: I’m tired, you know? You are tired too, right {f_botName}? Right?
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
Bot: Uhm, not really.
This bratty bot! M-my legs are giving out…
Lady Annalie: You heard?! Let the girl have her fun, you were keeping her for yourself long enough!
You: Ugh… {{wi}}Please, have mercy…
Bot: If you want to go home that bad, then I guess we should.
A-an Angel!
Lady Annalie: Huh?! If he wants to go that bad he can go by himself!
#bot.Expression.Blush
Bot: Maybe so, but…{{wi}} I want to be a good girlfriend.
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Oh look at you, being all lovey-dovey with each other~ If you guys are like that then I have no choice.
#Annalie.Face.sad
#bot.Expression.NoBlush
Lady Annalie: I can always have my fun later I guess…
#Annalie.Face.normal
You: Thank you for being so considerate…
Lady Annalie: Well then, see you later! I hope you will be back soon! 
Lady Annalie: If you come alone next time I will kick your ass Anon!
You: Y-yes…{{wi}} Lady Annalie…
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
#bot.Expression.Blush
Lady Annalie: That’s the spirit!
#bot.Expression.NoBlush
Lady Annalie: You better keep an eye on your girlfriend! If you let such a girl get away you will regret it forever! Bye~
You and Bot: Bye! See you later!
